messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — I ran a site scan and found 2 broken links in /kb/runtime-guide (Deployment patterns + Canary rollouts). Staging asset paths return 404. Noticed `/kb/runtime-guide#canary` resolves but the image links under that section 404. Anyone owning runtime-guide?
Elaine: @Alex do you still own runtime-guide? :eyes:
Alex: I handed that to Maria last month. @Maria?
Maria: Yup, I own it now. I actually caught one of these earlier — our staging CDN path changed yesterday. Quick fix should be a one-line replace: `/assets/staging/` -> `/assets/main/` in the md files. I can open a tiny PR. Want a code review or can we auto-merge?
Sam: Please open the PR. Small change, auto-merge ok for me but ping for at least one review. @docs-bot can you run linkcheck on the branch? :thumbsup:
docs-bot: link-checker: queued scan for branch `maria/docs-staging-path-fix-171980`. Preliminary: 3 files touched, 2 broken asset links fixed, 1 internal shortlink that redirects (shortlink/123 -> /kb/unknown). Full report attached to the PR once scan completes.
Alex: I'll do a quick CR tomorrow morning. If this needs to go out tonight, @Priya can pair for a hotmerge once tests pass.
Maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4892 — description includes the sed snippet I used: 
```
git grep -l "assets/staging" | xargs sed -i 's|/assets/staging/|/assets/main/|g'
```
Sam: Looks good. Tag the PR with `docs: small` and include a changelog note 'docs: fix staging asset links'. No customer-facing notification required.
Elaine: Did you also add/update frontmatter owner metadata so we don't lose ownership next handoff?
Maria: Added `owner: docs/runtime` to the frontmatter of the runtime-guide files and left a comment in the PR about follow-up to check shortlink/123.
Alex: Left one minor whitespace nit in the PR description; otherwise LGTM. Approving now. :white_check_mark:
Priya: If Alex approves, I can merge after CI green. I'll watch the link-checker report too.
Maria: Merged and backported to `release/2026.03.docs`. Link-checker passed post-merge. Thanks y'all! :tada: 
Sam: Awesome — thanks for the quick turnaround. I'll add a note to the docs sprint board to sweep shortlinks next week.
Elaine: Cheers — marking as resolved in the KB tracker.
